evidence_boundary: The engine publishes multiple primitive two-sided members, raw side jets, and coupled admissible tangents. Gluing is kinematic and built from Q target data. No action or equation-of-motion closure is evaluated.
limits: The member engine is finite and sampled; no convergence or continuous-family theorem follows.
Metric normal jets are primitive inputs only; GHY, R5, R3, and their variations are not evaluated here.
B traces are not identified across sides and the oriented BF interface equation remains open.
R_plus and R_minus are local groupoid representatives, not new bifundamental dynamical fields.
Action, JVP, Euler--Green, C1/N1, LOCK-1 Phase-A, BV--BFV, B4, and B5 remain fail-closed.

family_spec.formula_frame: E_Q=GramSchmidt(gamma,T=t); E_Q is recomputed and never an independent tangent
